    Add boundary, viewport and time machinery to the map

    add_map_controls.Rd

    Everything that goes on the map after the data layers: the boundary polygons, the viewport, the JavaScript that drives the time control, and the vignette last so that it sits above the markers it dims.

    Usage

    add_map_controls(
  map,
  borough_sf = NULL,
  vignette_overlay = NULL,
  vignette = FALSE,
  bbox,
  interactive = TRUE,
  display_times,
  boundary_labels = FALSE,
  zoom_level = NULL,
  lazy_payload = NULL
)

    Arguments

    map

    Leaflet map object

    borough_sf

    Boundary polygons, or NULL for no boundary

    vignette_overlay

    Dimming shape from create_vignette_overlay()

    vignette

    Logical; whether to draw the dimming

    bbox

    Viewport bounding box

    interactive

    TRUE for the HTML pass, FALSE for the image pass

    display_times

    Time steps offered by the control

    boundary_labels

    Logical; label the boundary areas

    zoom_level

    Fixed zoom, or NULL to fit bbox

    lazy_payload

    Embedded JSON payload when lazy rendering is in use

    Value

    The map with controls added

    Details

    Which JavaScript is attached depends on how the map was built. With a lazy payload (item 6) the temporal markers are Canvas shapes restyled per step from the embedded JSON, so the lazy controller is attached and there are no per-step Leaflet layers to cache. Otherwise the layers were pre-built and the smaller layer-cache script is enough.
